products.name: EduRestaurant Web
products.tagline: Restaurant billing and orders in the browser.
products.audience: Restaurants, cafes, fast food outlets and takeaways.
intro: Take orders, run the tables and print bills from any browser, at the counter or in the office.
It works with the Restaurant Manager Android app, so waiters can take orders on their phones.
features: Dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders, with table status at a glance.
Quick bills with discounts, taxes and payment type.
Items, categories and prices kept in one place.
Sales and closing reports for the owner.
faq: Do I need to install anything?
No. It runs in the browser; open the demo with the login shown.
Can it work with the Android app?
Yes, the Restaurant Manager app takes orders on the phone.

products.name: EduBS RT Web
products.tagline: Business Solution for retail stores, now in the browser.
products.audience: Retail shops, marts and stores with one or more counters.
intro: The retail edition of Edusoft Business Solution, running in the browser. Counter sales, stock and accounts stay in one system.
features: Fast billing at one or more counters.
Balances and ledgers for every party.
Daily sales, profit and stock reports.
faq: Is this the same as EduBSSTD Web?
It is the retail edition of the same Business Solution, set up for shop counters.
Can I try it now?
Yes. Open the demo with the login shown.

products.name: EduBSSTD Web Edition
products.tagline: Business Solution Standard, now in the browser.
products.audience: Businesses already on the desktop version who want to log in from any PC or branch.
intro: This is the web version of our Business Solution Standard software. Your staff keep the screens they already know, and you stop installing the software on every computer.
It's new, so the demo is still being filled in. Ask us for a walkthrough if something you need isn't there yet.
features: Chrome, Edge or Firefox. Nothing to install on each PC.
Sales, purchases, stock and party ledgers work the way your team is used to.
Every branch and user works on the same data on the server.
faq: Can we move our desktop data across?
Yes. We migrate your existing Business Solution data when we set you up.
Do we need internet all the time?
Yes, it is a web system. If your connection is unreliable, talk to us about a local server.

products.name: EduCampus Core ERP
products.tagline: Admissions, attendance and results for schools and colleges.
products.audience: Schools, colleges and academies, single campus or several.
intro: EduCampus keeps student records, attendance and exam results in one place, so the office isn't chasing registers at the end of every term.
It pairs with EduCampus Finance & Accounts if you also want fee vouchers and school accounts.
features: Student profile, class and section, guardian details and history.
Daily attendance for students and staff, with monthly reports.
Enter marks once and print result cards for the whole class.
Head office can see every branch from one login.
faq: Is there a parent app?
Not in this demo. Tell us if you need one and we'll discuss it.
Can it print our own result card format?
Yes, we set up result cards to match your school's design.

products.name: EduCampus Finance & Accounts
products.tagline: Fee vouchers, collections and school accounts.
intro: Print fee vouchers for every class, record what comes in, and see who hasn't paid. Expenses and ledgers sit in the same system, so month-end doesn't need a separate spreadsheet.
features: Monthly or yearly vouchers for a class or the whole school.
Mark payments and pull a defaulter list by class.
Vouchers, cash book and ledgers for the institution.

products.name: Pharmacy Management System
products.tagline: Billing, batches and expiry for pharmacies.
products.audience: Medical stores, pharmacy chains and hospital pharmacies.
intro: Fast counter billing with batch and expiry tracked on every item. Reorder lists come from minimum stock levels, so you order what's actually running out.
Chains get a warehouse and branch transfers, with accounts and payroll built in.
features: Expiry alerts, and min/max levels for each item.
Barcode scanning, discounts and prescription sales.
Reorder lists, purchase returns and supplier payments, by manufacturer.
Stock transfers between the warehouse and shops.
Vouchers, ledgers, income statement and balance sheet.
faq: Can it handle several branches?
Yes. Each branch has its own stock, and head office sees all of them.
Can I see near-expiry stock?
Yes. There's an expiry report, so you can return stock to the supplier in time.

products.name: Digital Invoicing (FBR)
products.tagline: FBR digital invoices with HS codes and provincial tax handled.
products.audience: Sales-tax registered businesses that must issue FBR digital invoices.
intro: Made for Pakistan's FBR digital invoicing requirement. HS codes, units of measure and the correct provincial sales tax are applied automatically, and each invoice is validated before it goes out.
workflow: Set up your products with their HS codes once.
Create the invoice. Tax type and rates are filled in for the buyer's province.
The invoice is validated and submitted.
Keep the digital record for reporting.
features: Codes applied automatically, so you aren't typing them.
Picks the right tax type for each province.

products.name: EduFuel
products.tagline: Fuel station management: tanks, nozzles, shifts and credit customers.
products.audience: Petrol pumps, CNG stations and fuel dealers.
intro: Keep every litre accounted for. Record nozzle readings and tank dips each shift, and see sales, stock and cash in one place.
features: Opening and closing readings per shift.
Fuel stock, purchases and dip records.
Fleet and company accounts with balances.
Cash, card and credit for every shift.
faq: When can I try the demo?
The live demo link is coming soon. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll show it to you.

products.name: Edu Enterprise
products.tagline: One system for accounts, stock, sales and branches.
products.audience: Growing companies with several branches or departments.
intro: Run the whole business from one system: accounts, inventory, purchasing, sales and payroll, with reports across every branch.
features: Several branches and companies in one system.
faq: When can I try the demo?

products.name: Edu Pharmacy

intro: Fast counter billing with every item tracked by batch and expiry date, so nothing expires on the shelf unnoticed.
features: Expiry alerts before stock goes bad.
faq: When can I try the demo?
The live demo link is coming soon. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll show it to you.

products.name: Restaurant Manager App
products.tagline: Order taking and table management on Android.
products.audience: Restaurants, cafes and fast food outlets.
intro: Waiters take orders on an Android phone at the table, and the order goes straight through. Owners can check the day's sales from anywhere.
features: Menu on the phone, orders sent instantly.
See which tables are free, occupied or waiting for the bill.

products.name: Business Solution App
products.tagline: Orders, stock and balances from your phone.
products.audience: Owners and sales staff who are out of the office.
intro: The Android companion to Business Solution. Book orders in the market, check stock before you promise delivery, and look up what a customer owes.
features: Sales staff book orders on the spot.

products.name: Electric Store App
products.tagline: Your electric store's stock and sales on Android.
intro: Check stock and prices, record a sale, and see the day's takings from your phone. It works with Electric Store Management.
features: Record a sale and share the bill.
Sales and cash for the day.

about: Edusoft System Solutions has been writing business software in Pakistan since 2000. Our clients range from medical stores and restaurants to hospitals, schools and distributors.
Development and support are done by our own team in Multan. Every product can be customised to how your business works, and training for your staff is free, online or at your site.
